checks.label: README local link and Git whitespace checks
checks.command: $taskDocs = @('README.md', 'docs/audits/skill-installability-2026-10-09/README.md'); $checkedLinks = 0; foreach ($taskDoc in $taskDocs) { $documentText = [IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path (Get-Location) $taskDoc)); $basePath = Split-Path -Parent (Join-Path (Get-Location) $taskDoc); foreach ($match in [regex]::Matches($documentText, '\[[^\]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)')) { $destination = $match.Groups[1].Value; if ($destination -match '^(?:[a-z]+:|#)') { continue }; $relative = ($destination -split '#', 2)[0]; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $basePath $relative))) { throw "Missing link in ${taskDoc}: $destination" }; $checkedLinks++ } }; Write-Output "README local links verified: $checkedLinks"; git diff --check; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; git diff --numstat -- README.md; git status --short
